Today, I had my cat spayed.

The doctor was very kind and explained everything thoroughly, and patiently answered all my questions. I felt very at ease entrusting my cat to their care.

The surgery went smoothly, and my cat is doing well without any problems.

I'm so glad I chose this hospital.

Thank you very much!
The teacher was kind, but the price was a bit high...

February 5, 2021: Daichan (16 years and 3 months old) passed away.
Two times, three years ago and last year, his kidney values ​​were bad and the vet told me to prepare for the worst, but he always recovered. So I thought he would recover this time too, but he was gone in an instant.
The day before, the vet gave him an IV drip, and he was wandering around his room for 30 minutes; I thought he was fine.
Since last summer, taking care of him (feeding and diapers) had become difficult, and I thought my elderly mother couldn't handle it. My room was a no-pets room, but he was a dog that didn't bark unnecessarily (he only barked once or twice a year), so I kept him in my room. However, since last week he started crying at night, and I tried various things to figure out what to do. I found that he wouldn't cry if I let him sleep on my chest or stomach, so I've been letting him sleep on me, which has meant I've been sleep-deprived every night. 😁
It would be tough if this continued, but I kept doing it every night for Daichan's sake.
This morning at 4-5 o'clock, he barked! My wife noticed what he said and spoke to him, and he calmed down, so we went to sleep too. When we woke up after 7am, he was gone.
Maybe that dog was saying his final goodbyes before he left us 🤔
He was such a gentle and kind dog who never barked unnecessarily at anyone.
Thank you for coming to our home and thank you for everything 🙇‍♂️
Right now, our whole family is gathered at my parents' house.
To the doctors and staff of Mejiro Animal Hospital
To the teachers and graduates of Mejiro Grooming School
Thank you so much for everything 🙇‍♂️

We've been going to them since our first Yorkshire Terrier, Gen (1982) 😊
Previously, there was a grooming school attached, and we used to have our dogs shampooed, cut, have their nails trimmed, and have their ears cleaned as training dogs.
If we told them our desired cut, they would do it.
We had long hair around our ears, so they even braided it for us sometimes 😊
Also, after the cut, they always put a cute handmade ribbon on him.
The doctors and nurses are so kind that neither my first nor second child dislikes going to the hospital.
The orange ribbon is for Halloween.
Anyone who has had their hair cut by a former patient will probably recognize who it is from the photo.
Dai-chan turned 15 years old.
He sleeps 80% of the day (lol).
Thanks to everyone, he's doing well 😊
First photo:
1982-1998 Gen
From the second photo onwards:
2005-2021 Dai

My cat has developed a malignant melanoma in his mouth. Surgery would require the removal of his entire jaw, leaving him unable to eat on his own. Since he's elderly, I didn't want him to have to go through that, so I asked the doctor to prescribe steroids and supplements to help him live a more comfortable life. Dr. Iwase is a wonderful doctor who truly cares for both owners and animals, and provides examinations that take both parties' concerns into consideration.

I asked over the phone if they trim cat nails, but they said, "No, we don't, so please go to another veterinary clinic."

Slammed.
I don't think it's clear in writing, but they said it in a really nasty way.
I wish they'd been a little more polite.

I feel at ease attending because the teacher is always kind and provides thorough explanations and advice.

Please be careful not to go without calling ahead, as the teacher is the only one there and the clinic is sometimes closed.
This was the first time I had to apply for a vaccination certificate before I could get one, and when I asked people in the dog community, I was told that the hospital had a bad reputation.

I was recommended this clinic by someone passing by on a walk, and I continued to go there until I moved. It's a shame I don't know who that person was, but I'm truly grateful.

I love both the doctor and his staff. I have yet to meet a veterinarian I trust more than him.

The doctor also took care of me when my dog ​​gave birth.

He made several house calls during my dog's final moments.

The prices are reasonable, and I loved him because I could easily talk to him about anything.

From the phone conversation, I could tell that the head doctor was very kind, even before I visited. The other staff members were also very helpful, and the atmosphere was great, so I felt confident leaving my child in their care.
This is a wonderful vet. They focus on each individual dog, not just their breed. They also have a grooming salon attached, and the staff are very kind and attentive.

This is a truly wonderful hospital. ( ӹ꒳​ӹ )

My cat was sick, so I had to go to the hospital on short notice. The director was very kind and responded quickly. ( ӹ꒳​ӹ )

I will definitely recommend this hospital to friends who have pets. ( ӹ꒳​ӹ )
